items.quote: Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes
items.claim: Abraham describes himself as dust and ashes in humility before addressing God

items.quote: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five?
items.claim: Abraham asks whether God would destroy the city if five righteous people were lacking from fifty

items.quote: If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it
items.claim: God states he will not destroy the city if forty-five righteous people are found in it
